title: Tough Egg

moves.title: Hatch
effects: Hatch and transform into a Hatchling

move_pattern: Starts with Hatch. Then cycles: Nibble
notes: ToughEgg applies HatchPower on spawn. On the Hatch move, it transforms into a Hatchling with 20-23 HP (19-22 base at A8). After hatching, it only uses Nibble attacks. The creature's Title changes from 'Tough Egg' to 'Hatchling' after transforming.
